services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Students of all kinds are welcome to explore the intersection of tradition and modern craft at the Bill Waller Craft Center. Discover the rich history of Mississippi craft through our one-of-a-kind facility. Regardless of age, school, or anything else, there is truly something at the Craftsmen’s Guild of Mississippi for everyone. Explore our unique architecture, the beautiful Natchez Trace, or the original handmade crafts in the Artisan Gallery. To schedule during the school year, email the form below to info@mscrafts.org, and we will accommodate you shortly! Thank you for scheduling your visit! blurb: The Waller Craft Center, located in Ridgeland, MS, near the scenic Natchez Trace Parkway, is the headquarters for The Craftsmen’s Guild of Mississippi. The architecture is spacious and inspiring, framing the natural setting and serving as the heart of the Guild.
